name: VTU CBCS 2018 Scheme
description: VTU Choice Based Credit System (CBCS) 2018 Scheme — 40 marks CIE + 60 marks SEE

in_semester.name: Continuous Internal Evaluation (CIE)
in_semester.notes: CIE typically consists of two IA tests (20 marks each, best/average), assignments, and quiz components.

instructions: Answer any FIVE full questions, choosing at least ONE from each module.
Module 1: Q.1 or Q.2, Module 2: Q.3 or Q.4, Module 3: Q.5 or Q.6, Module 4: Q.7 or Q.8, Module 5: Q.9 or Q.10.
Neat diagrams must be drawn wherever necessary.
Figures to the right indicate full marks.

question_structure.description: Five modules, each with an OR-pair (2 questions per module). Answer one full question from each module (5 questions total). Each question typically has sub-questions (a+b) or (a+b+c).
